answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. The canyon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the bridge is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on time-locked escrow with arbitration fallback. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wander of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
